candidates.name: Unison
candidates.reason: Three deterministic canaries passed on 2026-10-15: exact search for Give It Up / Don Toliver, direct ID 31, and direct ID 1494 Love Never Felt So Good / Michael Jackson. Direct reads retained raw TTML; parsed tracks have 341/441 cues including explicit line and positioned word cues. Source attribution is https://unison.boidu.dev; individual lyric-text rights remain unverified and no ODbL claim is made.

candidates.name: Start Jamming
candidates.reason: Documented public read API; search has object/array response variants, index is keyed by ID, and artist can be absent. Chords use normalized measure arrays; cannot claim lyric-aligned chords. Requires a supported adapter and real canaries before activation.

candidates.name: Lyrica
candidates.reason: Open-source self-hostable aggregator; repository documentation alone does not establish a supported public upstream service or independent data coverage. Investigate deployment/access requirements before proposing activation.
